notes.title: What’s New in Eden Survivors – Update Recap!
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders,

We’ve been working hard since launch—and it’s time to show off what’s new in Eden Survivors!

🧠 Major Improvements:


Polished tutorial and smoother early-game flow
Bug fixes & performance boosts across many devices
Better in-game pause menu
Better information on drops inside the shop under the pods Info button. 


🌑 Coming Soon – Lunar Explore Event:


Earn Sonar Tickets by playing
Uncover rewards on a 5x5 grid
Finish 3 lines to clear the board & earn big prizes
Discover Golden Asteroids to unlock the Golden Lunar Fest
Trade Lunar Crystals in the new event shop
Event duration: 7 days + 2-day exchange grace period


🎉 Coming Soon - Pyrocynical Collab:

More info will be revealed soon on discord!


🚀 Now’s the perfect time to return or start fresh.
Join our community on Discord for more surprises and tips!
